card.name: Warning and Information heading words
card.fires_on: The words Warning, Warn, Info or Information when they act as a heading or label, most often right after Boxed or BOXED in label cross-references.

modes.label: Boxed Warning reference
modes.description: The word WARNING or Warning right after BOXED or Boxed in a cross-reference to the boxed warning.

modes.label: Information heading
modes.description: The word Info or Information used as a section label or credit line.
